correctness.rationale: The claim is exact for the seven-site Fano triple model, every real signed-line strength and nonnegative field. Using the 2-(7,3,1) design identities gives T=2k(4-k)+8N3-7; classifying all 128 spin subsets yields 16 signatures. At positive field five and only five affine ground-energy terms survive; a sixth term is dominated over the entire half-line. The zero-field degeneracy is 8/32/24 around lambda=-2, and the partition function follows from exact Boltzmann sums. Two differently computed complete finite-state censuses and 4100 exact rational parameter checks passed. No finite enumeration is extrapolated to infinite size.

value.rationale: The Fano Steiner system is the smallest symmetric 3-uniform incidence design and a natural laboratory for higher-order Ising interactions. A single reversed line induces a structurally forced cost of two additional unfavorable lines, with a sharp signed-coupling threshold lambda=-2, 32-way coexistence, and several exact field-induced magnetization plateaux. The five-affine-function complete field envelope and three-cosh finite-temperature partition function provide a motivated exact benchmark rather than an arbitrary selected state count. The claim is explicitly finite-size.
